profile.description: AIA Group Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides life insurance based financial services in Hong Kong. The company offers life insurance, accident, and health insurance and savings plans; and employee benefits, credit life, and pension services to corporate clients. It is also involved in the distribution of investment and other financial services products. It sells its products through a network of agents and partners in Mainland China, Macau, Thailand, Singapore, Malaysia, Australia, Cambodia, Indonesia, Myanmar, New Zealand, the Philippines, South Korea, Sri Lanka, Taiwan, Brunei, Vietnam, and India. AIA Group Limited was founded in 1919 and is headquartered in Central, Hong Kong.

summary: AIA Group reported H1 2026 operating profit after tax of $4.2B, up 13% per share, with record value of new business rising 10% to $3.2B.
Company raised interim dividend 10% and now expects to exceed its 9-11% operating profit per share CAGR target for 2023-2026 period.
Operating ROE hit record 17.5%, up 200 basis points YoY, driven by profitable new business and disciplined capital management.
Strong growth across all major markets: mainland China VONB up 20%, Hong Kong/Macau up 10%, India's Tata AIA surged 31%.
Shares fell 1.51% to $71.90 in pre-market despite solid results, trading near 52-week low amid cautious investor sentiment.
